description: MaxEnt reweighting of sherpa_prior_13TeV_pwg186p to Wan-Li N4LLp+N3LO. Per event, fully local: w_rew = w0 * exp( sum_k lambda_physical[k]*phi_k - log_norm_shift ). The shift already fixes the normalization (sum w_rew = sum w0); no global max or renormalization needed.

feature_convention.phi_k: product over the two parts of moment name "A×B" (A=rt-side, B=dphi-side)
feature_convention.monomials: rt^k=rt**k, dphi^k=dphi**k, lnrt^k=log(rt)**k, lndphi^k=log(dphi)**k, const^0=1; parts within a side joined by *
feature_convention.vars: rt=qT/m_ll, dphi=pi-Delta_phi_ll; clip log args at 1e-12

standardization_note: lambda_physical already folds in the unit-std feature scaling; apply directly to raw monomials. (lambda_standardized + sF,sG given only for cross-check.)

gating.combine: w = w0*exp(logit - log_norm_shift) for ALL events (no hand-off to the prior at high qT)
gating.why: NLO POWHEG (no multijet merging): the high-qT tail is shower-only, nothing there is more accurate than the reweighting target
gating.multiplicity: not applicable: this prior has a single hard emission, so there is no merging multiplicity to preserve; the set is delivered ungated.

health.note: MEASURED on all n_events with the exported lambda. neff_gated = N_eff of the GATED deliverable weights, the same functional select_stable.py prunes on; stability_floor is the winner set provenance floor (rescaled to n_events). closure_pct = per-moment |<phi_k>_w/T_k - 1|. max/min(logit-C) are over events with beta(qT)>0.

closure: MEASURED on all 48,623,807 events with the lambdas in this file: the 19 moments of this set are reproduced to median 0.000% / max 0.001%; N_eff of the deliverable = 99.29% (prior 99.51%).

rate.description: Overall rate normalization. The MaxEnt weight preserves the prior's normalization (sum w = sum w0) and transfers only the shape; K = sigma_calc / sigma_prior sets the absolute scale. Every fitted moment is normalized by the total rate, so K does not enter the fit and changes no normalized distribution. Apply it where the calculation is in control: apply_lambdas multiplies the reweighted branch by K and leaves the generator's tail above the hand-off untouched (rate_tail=True scales every event instead). The total rate of the sample is then K x (bulk) + (tail). Per scheme use per_scheme[s].K with schemes[s] of lambda_export_variations.json.
rate.phase_space: inclusive, m_ll >= 40 GeV, all lepton rapidities (the calculation's normalization moment); the prior sample is generated with the same mass cut
rate.sigma_prior_source: sum of the stored per-event weights (1.04641e+11 pb) divided by the number of showered events (51,037,880), not by the 48,623,807 events that pass m_ll > 40 GeV. POWHEG unweighted events all carry the same |w| = sigma_gen, so the mean over a cut subset returns the generation cross section (2152.06 pb, for the m_ll > 35 GeV generation cut) rather than the cross section of the selection.
rate.sigma_calc_definition: integral of the tabulated N4LL'+N3LO calculation over its full range (the g0 moment, dphi^0 x lndphi^0): m_ll >= 40 GeV, all lepton rapidities, one lepton flavour, QCD only. Cross-check: integrating the tabulated rT density reproduces it to 0.1%. Compare sigma_prior in the SAME phase space before forming K.
